title: Exit-Aware Admission Control for Multi-Robot Plans (synthetic fixture)
abstract: SYNTHETIC TEST RECORD, not a real paper. An admission controller rejects joint robot plans whose predicted footprints overlap a marked human exit corridor. In 120 simulated episodes it rejected all 21 blocking plans with a median check time of 9 ms, assuming bounded travel time.
